{"version":1,"content":"

HOW TO USE

ONE workflow that does two jobs with the same model: A makes a picture from text, B edits a picture you give it. Click A or B and press Run. No second workflow to open, no wires to move.

 Steps

  1. Click A on Switch Source Pixaroma for text to image, or B for an edit.
  2. Fill in the A nodes (prompt A, size) or the B nodes (picture, prompt B).
  3. Press Run.

 Why Switch Source

A normal switch flips ONE wire. Here four wires must flip together: the prompt, the negative, the width and the height. Switch Source has rows: each row's A and B go to one output, and one click flips every row. Add rows with the Rows field and rename an output by clicking its name.

 The same trick swaps between two models, two LoRA setups or a local and an online node: wire one setup into A, the other into B.

 Something not working?

Each button opens the answer on the Pixaroma help page.

Nodes look different from the video

{"version":1,"content":"

WHAT EACH NODE DOES

The colour of a node tells you what kind of node it is. Nothing here needs changing except the blue ones.

 Models to download

Orange. Each one needs a file from the Download Models note.

  • Load Diffusion Model (Flux 2 Klein 9B) - The image model, Flux 2 Klein 9B from Black Forest Labs. It is a fast 4-step model that can make a picture from words AND change a picture you give it.
  • Load CLIP (Qwen 3 8B, reads the prompt) - Reads your prompt and turns the words into something the image model understands.
  • Load VAE (Flux 2) - Turns the finished render into a picture you can see, and a picture into the model's own format.

 The steps you set

Blue, and numbered. These are the only nodes you need to touch.

  • Prompt Pixaroma (A. text to image prompt) - A only: describe the picture you want.
  • Sizes Pixaroma (A. picture size) - A only: the picture size.
  • Load Image Mini Pixaroma (B. picture to edit) - B only: the picture to edit.
  • Longest Side Pixaroma (B. work size) - B only: makes the longest side 1024 and passes its size on.
  • Prompt Pixaroma (B. edit prompt) - B only: say what to change in the picture.
  • Switch Source Pixaroma (1. click A or B) - Flips four wires at once between two setups. Side A sends the text to image prompt and the Sizes size to the sampler; side B sends the edit (your picture + the edit prompt) and the picture's size. Click A or B on the node. Only the chosen side runs, so in A the picture is not even loaded.
  • Seed Pixaroma (2. random or fixed) - The seed. F (fixed) gives the same result every Run, R (random) a new one each Run.

 The work

Green. They run by themselves.

  • CLIP Text Encode (A prompt) - Reads prompt A.
  • ConditioningZeroOut (A negative) - An empty negative for A.
  • CLIP Text Encode (B prompt) - Reads prompt B.
  • ConditioningZeroOut (B negative) - An empty negative for B.
  • VAE Encode (B picture to latent) - Turns picture B into the model's format.
  • ReferenceLatent (B picture, positive) - Hands picture B to Klein as the picture to edit, with prompt B.
  • ReferenceLatent (B picture, negative) - The same picture, for the empty negative.
  • Empty Flux 2 Latent (blank canvas) - The blank canvas, at the size the switch sends: from Sizes in A, from your picture in B.
  • KSampler (4 steps) - The render: 4 steps, CFG 1, euler, simple. It gets its prompt and size from the switch.
  • VAE Decode (latent to picture) - Turns the finished render into a picture.

 The result

Dark red, at the end.

  • Preview Image Pixaroma (the picture, saved) - Shows the picture and saves it into ComfyUI/output/Two Jobs.

 Readouts

Dark. Nothing to set: they show you what happened.

  • Run Timer - The dark clock above the result shows how long the last Run took.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Nodes Info","icon":"node-v5","color":"#3d7cc9"}}

{"version":1,"content":"

RUN TIMES

Measured on a 24 GB RTX 4090 with this workflow, with the models already loaded. A different card gives different numbers, but the shape holds: the time grows with the number of pictures and their size.

JobSizeTime
A: text to image1024 x 1024about 1.8 s
B: edit1024 x 1024about 3 s

 The first Run of the session

The first Run after starting ComfyUI also has to load the models from disk (about 18 GB for Klein and its text encoder), so it takes longer. After that they stay loaded.

 On a 16 GB card

Timed on an RTX 4060 Ti 16 GB with 32 GB of RAM:

  • Klein took about 3 to 6 times as long, about 10 s even for one picture: Klein and its text encoder (17 GB together) do not fit in 16 GB, so parts of them load again on every Run, and a second Run is no faster.

","buttonColor":"#f66744","lineColor":"#f66744","backgroundColor":"#2a2a2a","info":{"title":"Run Times","icon":"run-timer","color":"#3f9a4f"}}
